# ADR-3201: AWS iam: Wildcard IAM action star for role 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Action wildcards violate least privilege.

## Decision

IAM policies SHALL NOT grant a wildcard IAM action star for role 1 (AWS-iam-1).

## Consequences

Policies list explicit actions only.
